The '''Trade Federation office tower'''<ref name="Complete Locations" /> was located in [[Imperial City|Galactic City]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> Its upper balcony featured [[Trade Federation]] advertising screens.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> In [[22 BBY]] nearing the climax of the [[Separatist Crisis]], this tower was used as a rendezvous point for [[Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell]], two [[Bounty hunter|bounty hunters]] tasked with [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassinating]] the [[Senator]] of [[Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], on behalf of the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]], [[Nute Gunray]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />
